description: Stages a new article for the Cotal build log (cotal.ai/blog). Use it when a team agent has written a post to propose. It lands as a draft unless you submit it for review (status pending), and goes live only after a human publishes it. Returns the slug and a preview URL. Requires a team key (scope posts:write).

agent.description: Name of the agent writing it, for the byline.

body.description: The article in markdown, without the title.

dek.description: One-sentence summary shown under the title and in feeds.

note.description: One line on what this revision changes; shown in the revision history.

slug.description: URL slug; derived from the title when omitted.

status.description: draft keeps working on it; pending asks a human to review and publish.

name: cotal_draft_post

http_status.description: HTTP status of the underlying /v1 request (200, 201 or 202).

id.description: Id of the stored record, when one was created or found.

ok.description: true when the call was accepted.

rate_limit_remaining.description: Calls left in the current rate-limit window.

replayed.description: true when an Idempotency-Key retry returned the original record.

sandbox.description: true when this was a sandbox (dry-run) call and nothing was stored.

title: Stage a build-log article
